goals: Verify that DtdUtils.readyDtdService completes immediately and ensures the WAITERS map is empty when the Dart Tooling Daemon service is already ready.

Verify that DtdUtils.readyDtdService correctly adds a project to the WAITERS map when the Dart Tooling Daemon service is not ready, and subsequently clears the map upon the service's asynchronous completion.
activities: Initialize Mockito mocks for the test class.
Obtain the project instance from the test fixture.
Register a mock DartToolingDaemonService for the project.
Configure the mock service to report WebSocket as ready.
Call readyDtdService to initiate the service readiness check.
Assert that the service readiness future is completed.
Assert that the internal WAITERS map in DtdUtils is empty.
Configure the mock service to report WebSocket as not ready.
Create a new instance of DtdUtils.
Call readyDtdService to initiate the service readiness check.
Assert that the project is added to the internal WAITERS map.
Reconfigure the mock service to report WebSocket as ready.
Wait for the service readiness future to complete, with a 5-second timeout.
Assert that the future has completed.
Poll and wait for the internal WAITERS map to become empty, with a 2-second timeout.
Assert that the internal WAITERS map is empty.
